name: multicloud-advisor
description: Audit a Kubernetes cluster's cloud spend end to end: install the read-only Multicloud Advisor, then drive it over MCP through diagnosis, cloud-access grants, the savings counterfactual, the quota increases that make the cheaper fleet actually provisionable, and a report the customer is shown rather than sent a link to. The skill carries the shape of the run; every permission list, quota code and region list is served live by the Advisor you just installed, so nothing packaged here can go stale.
